Sunita Ahuja confronts Govinda and Rani at Ganpati Darbar

Sunita Ahuja became angry after seeing her husband Govinda together with a woman identified as Rani at a Ganpati Darbar. Holding a dog in her lap, she said, "Man is a deceiver." The incident was reported by Hindi‑language outlets Zee News and Dainik Jagran.
